title: They always ask for more money
body: I already paid twice for premium and they still ask me to pay again even if I get a version for a lifetime
author: Mark Greener

title: Ótimo para quem tem ADHD
body:
Esta oferta de um ano gratuito permite explorar todas as apps e definidamente que irei adquirir quando o período experimental terminar.
Para quem tem ADHD é uma excelente ajuda!!!
(Todas as apps to “the growth bundle”)
author: monicacidnobre

title: Some more features would be nice
body:
- Edit habit view visibility / filter or sort
- Add timer based habits / pomodoro feature
- Auto dark mode / more themes 
- Auto sync with other devices
- Folder or Label integration

title: SAD

title: Love it
body:
I loved this app it's amazing to control all my habits. I only think that should be more options to edit the widget...
I only want a few habits to appear on my widget not all of them.
When that is possible i will be 100% happy with this app!!!
author: Afonsos239

title: Love it!
body:
Straighten to the point, no distractions, beautifully designed.

Wish it could backup automatically so I can switch from my iPhone to iPad.

And I’d really appreciate if you guys could launch an iPad version.

Again these are personal issues and I don’t think they should impact the 5 star rating that this app deserves!
